headline.zh: 复旦管院旁站饮数学风咖啡
headline.en: Standing-bar coffee near Fudan Business School

traits.zh: 临街设4-6个室外藤编椅小圆桌
traits.en: 4–6 outdoor rattan chairs and small round tables on the street

traits.zh: 招牌含kiri法酪拿铁、重瓣玫瑰布列夫
traits.en: Signature drinks include Kiri Fromage Latte and Double-Petal Rose Brioche

traits.zh: 营业时间07:30-18:00，覆盖午休高峰
前身为2015年苏州诚品书店MatrixCoffee
traits.en: Originally MatrixCoffee at Suzhou Eslite Bookstore in 2015

traits.zh: 价格20~48元，曾推星期二买一赠一

focus.zh: 站饮为主，无办公设施证据
focus.en: Standing-bar format, no work setup observed

energy.zh: 中午时段白领客流密集

linger.zh: 室外座位少且为站立/短坐设计
linger.en: Limited outdoor seating suited for brief stays

adventure.zh: 用数学演算方案，推重瓣玫瑰布列夫等创意饮品
adventure.en: Math-based brewing; creative drinks like Double-Petal Rose Brioche
